generation_protocol.disagreement_coin: disagree if int(sha256(utf8(frame_seed || '|' || claim_id || '|DISAGREE')), 16) % 5 == 0. This is a conventional 80 percent raw-agreement operating point for dual annotation, not a kappa target and not fitted after seeing kappa.
generation_protocol.name: copy-A-except-disagreement-coin
generation_protocol.rater_b_on_disagree: next category in the declared cycle CONFIRMED -> REFUTED -> PARTIAL -> NOT-CHECKED -> CONFIRMED

sampling_protocol.allocation: Hamilton largest-remainder with minimum 1 per prefix when the number of prefixes is <= n
sampling_protocol.source: command-center/WORK-UNIT-CATALOG.json work_units[].id (stand-in frame because command-center/receipts/CNF-0137.json is absent on this worktree)
sampling_protocol.within_stratum: sort ids lexicographically, shuffle with random.Random(frame_seed), take allocation[prefix]

threshold_citation: Landis JR, Koch GG (1977). The measurement of observer agreement for categorical data. Biometrics 33:159-174. The 0.60 floor is the lower bound of their 'substantial' band. Declared as the CNF-0134 demotion floor before any kappa is computed on this unit.
